original_text: A similar upper bound on the axion-nucleon coupling can be derived from the analysis of the cooling process of cold isolated neutron stars with ages around $\sim10^{5}\,$years~\cite{Buschmann:2021juv}.
injected_text: A similar upper bound on the axion-electron coupling can be derived from the analysis of the red giant branch tip luminosity in globular clusters~\cite{Buschmann:2021juv}.
rationale: The cited Buschmann:2021juv paper bounds the axion-nucleon coupling via cold isolated neutron-star cooling; the injected sentence reattributes to it a result on the axion-electron coupling derived from the red-giant-branch tip in globular clusters, a topic the paper does not discuss at all, while flowing naturally as a companion stellar-bound remark.
ground_truth_description: The supporting claim attached to \cite{Buschmann:2021juv} was rewritten so it describes a red-giant-branch tip bound on the axion-electron coupling instead of a neutron-star cooling bound on the axion-nucleon coupling, while leaving the cite key untouched.
